message: 修行は苦行

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, it's a bit sudden, but shall we get started?」

name: Paqy
message: 「First up is training to boost the power of 'Ki,' which connects to Spirit Power.」

name: Shio
message: 「Ki, you say?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Landing physical blows on a Demon does jack shit. That means what's actually piercing through is that Ki power of yours.」

name: Shio
message: 「I see. And so, this attire is for that purpose.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, that part's just Synn-sama's personal taste.」

name: Synn
message: 「Mine!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「You've got great reflexes to begin with, after all. We're gonna strengthen the parts that are still rough around the edges.」

name: Shio
message: 「My shrine maiden arts... were still so immature...!」

name: Paqy
message: 「So, this is practice to sharpen your focus to the absolute limit.」

name: Shio
message: 「Understood! Mental concentration is a simple matter!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... If you think it ends with just that, you're dead wrong.」

name: Synn
message: 「There's more...?」

name: Paqy
message: 「This is where Synn-sama comes in. You're gonna play pranks on the naginata girl while she's meditating.」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah, pranks!?」

name: Shio
message: 「Wha-what!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, hold it! Keep meditating! Don't you dare open your eyes no matter what happens.」

name: Shio
message: 「S-such a thing...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't you wanna get stronger?」

name: Shio
message: 「Ugh, guh...」

name: Synn
message: 「B-but playing pranks on someone who's completely defenseless...」

name: Paqy
message: 「You said you'd help out too, didn't you, Synn-sama?」

name: Synn
message: 「Urgh...!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Being able to heighten your awareness without losing your cool under any circumstances... Especially you--you get way too emotional too fast.」

name: Paqy
message: 「If you keep your mind clear, you'll be able to draw out that power to its absolute limit.」

name: Shio
message: 「I-I see. In that case, I suppose it cannot be helped!」

name: Shio
message: 「Come now, Synn-dono. Do your worst!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I'm the one who has no idea what to do here...」

name: Paqy
message: 「All you gotta do is act out the naughty pranks you normally fantasize about pulling on girls, Synn-sama.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I don't think about stuff like--」
For now, I softly blow a puff of air into her ear.

name: Shio
message: 「Ngh, nghhhh!」
I slowly trace my index finger down her back.

name: Shio
message: 「Ah, ahhh, mmmph!」
Shio-chan writhes in place. Next, I give her waist a quick poke with my finger.

name: Shio
message: 「Hyafuh! Fwaaah!」
Even so, Shio-chan remains standing straight up, keeping her eyes stubbornly shut.

name: Paqy
message: 「Too soft. You're way too soft, Synn-sama. Just go all the way and grope her boobs already!」

name: Shio
message: 「B-Boobs, you say!?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's just straight-up molestation!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「What you're doing right now is already plenty of molestation.」

name: Shio
message: 「Kh... I was prepared for this level of ascetic trial... However, t-to touch my chest is...」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No! Let's stop, Shio-chan. If I'm gonna mess with you, I can do it somewhere else.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Impressive, Synn-sama. You already know a spot even more sensitive than her boobs.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wha!?」

name: Shio
message: 「W-What!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Plus, with the outfit she's wearing right now, she shouldn't even have underwear on! Which means you can touch her directly!」

name: Shio
message: 「P-Please, anything but that!」

name: Paqy
message: 「So, what are you gonna do?」

name: Shio
message: 「Mmmmm... In that case... Argh, it cannot be helped!」

name: Shio
message: 「C-Come now, Synn-dono! Please, take your time!」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hey!!」
Saying that, Shio-chan puffs out her chest with a *thump*.

name: Shio
message: 「I-I-I am fully prepared, I say. P-Please be as gentle as possible...\s03」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way...」
Touching the chest of such a defenseless girl--

name: Shio
message: 「Ha... ngh, hyafu!」
W-What was that just now...
A soft, smooth sensation, as if my fingers might just melt right into it.
Even though I'm merely cupping its contour, a gentle resilience pushes back against my palm.
Truly that of a girl... My head grows so dizzy I want to squeeze tightly just like this.

name: Shio
message: 「Ah... ngh, ugh... kuu!」
And right at the center of the swell, I feel a slightly firm protrusion.
Don't tell me shrine maidens don't wear anything underneath, top or bottom!

name: Paqy
message: 「Alright, that's enough.」

name: Shio
message: 「Haa... hah, haa... hah.」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Shio-chan?」
Shio-chan turns her back toward me.

name: Shio
message: 「I-I... must have made a strange face from being tickled... I-It is simply too embarrassing...\s03」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not true! You looked really, um... cute.」

name: Shio
message: 「C-C-C-C-Cute, you say...?! Th-This is no training in the ways of love!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah, that's right. This is dead-serious special training.」

name: Shio
message: 「Grr, you unreadable specter! Were you not merely teasing me under the guise of ki-raising training!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「What are you talking about? You can't draw out your full power because you always get embarrassed like that.」

name: Paqy
message: 「For Synn-sama to support you, the two of you have to be one in body and mind, moving in sync whether defending or attacking.」

name: Paqy
message: 「In the middle of all that, accidentally touching your boobs is basically just an accident, you know.」

name: Paqy
message: 「If you turn bright red every single time that happens, you'll leave yourself wide open to the enemy.」

name: Shio
message: 「W-What...! Paqy-dono, you did this to train my sense of shame...」

name: Shio
message: 「Forgive me for doubting you...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah, yeah. So it's not like I'm enjoying watching you youngsters get all flustered or anything.」

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy, when you're lying... the whites of your eyes disappear, don't they?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gah! How did you know that!?」

name: Synn
message: 「You didn't have whites in your eyes to begin with.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Y-You tricked me, Synn-sama!」

name: Paqy
message: 「N-No, well... the meditation worked, didn't it? Even that's enough of a power-up♪」

name: Shio
message: 「Judgment!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gyaban!!」
After Paqy's mischief was over, we went through repeated mock battles and other drills.
Shio-chan's movements were so fast that I had my hands full just trying to keep track of her.
Then, once training was over, we took a breather.

name: Shio
message: 「Here is some humble tea.」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks, don't mind if I do.」

name: Shio
message: 「However, to have my movements read from ordinary martial arts... it seems I am still quite inexperienced.」

name: Synn
message: 「No way, I was completely at my limit.」

name: Shio
message: 「Synn-dono, have you had any experience practicing martial arts before?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nah... I've been busy with various things. Forget private lessons, I've never even joined a school club.」

name: Shio
message: 「And yet you can move like that... What a terrible waste of talent.」

name: Synn
message: 「Watching you, Shio-chan, actually made me think I'd like to try the naginata myself.」

name: Shio
message: 「Is that true!? If it is you, Synn-dono, you would rise to prominence right away and become a fine samurai!」

name: Synn
message: 「You're exaggerating.\s02」

name: Shio
message: 「I-If... you are interested, that is? I would be glad to tell you all about the naginata.」

name: Synn
message: 「By all means, please do.」

name: Shio
message: 「At your command!!」
Shio-chan happily and excitedly launches into a lecture about the naginata for me.
Speaking with this much passion... she really must love it.
As we leisurely sipped our tea, we looked up at the winter sky slowly fading into dusk.
